chunks: What the Shaykh, may Allah support him, informed me of, from Abū al-Qāsim Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from Muḥammad ibn Yaʿqūb, from ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Ḥafṣ ibn al-Bakhtarī, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
Do not drink from the milk of carrion-eating camels, and if anything from their sweat touches you, then wash it.

key_terms.أَلْبَانِ: milk; here, the milk of the camels in question
key_terms.الْجَلَّالَةِ: animals that habitually feed on filth
key_terms.فَاغْسِلْهُ: then wash it; an instruction to cleanse what was affected

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on the milk and sweat of al-ibil al-jallālah in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning camels that feed on filth. It prohibits drinking their milk and instructs that whatever is touched by their sweat should be washed, indicating a ruling related to taharah and najasah.
